upsert.title: UBC 2026 Hackathon (University Blockchain Conference)
upsert.summary: Online build week (13-20 Nov 2026) with top teams per track pitching live at the University Blockchain Conference finals at UT Austin on 21 Nov. Tracks: Agentic Payments & AI, DeFi & Onchain Apps, Consumer Apps.
upsert.location: Worldwide online; finals at UT Austin, Texas, USA
upsert.eligibility: Experienced developers and first-time participants; solo or team. Country and age rules not confirmed (official page could not be read).

prize.description: More than US$23,000 in cash across main prizes and sponsor bounties (Gemini, Solana, Arc, QuickNode); US$12,000 across three main tracks (US$2,000 / 1,250 / 750 per track).

notes: Details taken from an aggregator page; official page could not be opened. Submission cutoff time and timezone not stated.

upsert.title: IXH26 Italian XRPL Hackathon (Bari)
upsert.summary: In-person XRPL hackathon at the University of Bari, Italy, with three tracks: advanced cryptography for blockchain, XRPL applications and tokenisation of digital and real-world assets. Run with Ripple's University Blockchain Research Initiative and the Universities of Bari and Trento.
upsert.eligibility: Teams of three to eight. Eligible students may get accommodation support and travel reimbursement. Country and age rules not confirmed (official Luma page could not be read).

prize.description: EUR 12,000 in total, split across three tracks (EUR 2,000 / 1,200 / 800 per track).

notes: Aggregator pages disagree on event dates (20-21 vs 21-22 Nov); registration close 17 Nov per aggregator. Confirm on the Luma page. USD value approximate.
